Introduction

BADKIZ was a South Korean girl group formed by US Entertainment, debuting as a five-member group on March 24, 2014, with the single "Ear Attack". Over the years, the group experienced frequent lineup changes and briefly rebranded as HOT PLACE in 2019 before reverting to BADKIZ in 2020.

The group disbanded on October 14, 2020, after key members left to pursue other careers. In 2022, BADKIZ announced a return with a new lineup. However, more member changes followed throughout 2023 and 2024, including additions from other disbanded groups (e.g., G-reyish) and the return and departure of several past members.

As of late 2024, the group’s current lineup consists of members Byeol (formerly Hyeji) and Yeso. These two are the remaining active members following the latest departures of Soyee (formerly Seoeun) and Somin (formerly Eunyu).

Somin announced her departure on December 16, 2024, while Soyee updated her IG bio as “2018–2024 BADKIZ”, confirming the group disbanded once again.
